title: Comparative Evaluation of Deep-Learning based DoA Estimators for Real-Time ISAC Beamforming
abstract: arXiv:2610.20326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems rely on accurate Direction-of-Arrival (DoA) estimation for effective beamforming and spectral-efficiency enhancement. While numerous classical and deep-learning-based DoA estimation methods have been reported in the literature, their suitability for real-time ISAC operation remains insufficiently understood because practical deployment requires consideration of both estimation accuracy and computational latency. This paper presents a unified evaluation framework for systematically comparing classical and learning-based DoA estimators within an ISAC beamforming pipeline. Representative classical and learning-based DoA estimators, together with an ensemble architecture, are integrated with Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-based beamforming and evaluated under identical operating conditions. translated_title: 面向实时ISAC波束成形的基于深度学习的DoA估计器比较评估
translated_abstract: 集成感知与通信系统依赖于精确的到达方向（DoA）估计来实现有效的波束成形和频谱效率提升。尽管文献中已报道了大量经典的以及基于深度学习的DoA估计方法，但它们在实时ISAC运行中的适用性仍缺乏充分认识，因为实际部署需要同时考虑估计精度和计算延迟。本文提出了一个统一的评估框架，用于在ISAC波束成形流水线中系统地比较经典方法和基于学习的DoA估计器。文中将具有代表性的经典与基于学习的DoA估计器（包括一种集成架构）与基于奇异值分解（SVD）的波束成形相结合，并在完全相同的运行条件下进行评估。研究分析了DoA估计精度、推理延迟、波束成形权重生成时间以及（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个统一评估框架，将多种经典与深度学习DoA估计器嵌入相同的基于SVD的ISAC波束成形流水线中，在相同条件下系统比较其估计精度与计算延迟，以评估其实时部署的适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified evaluation framework that integrates representative classical and deep-learning-based DoA estimators into an identical SVD-based ISAC beamforming pipeline, systematically comparing their estimation accuracy and computational latency to assess suitability for real-time operation.
